explainer_content.short_definition: Hardcore after it learned angles, silence, abrasion, and architecture.
explainer_content.history_capsule: This road follows loud underground guitar music after hardcore, through labels and bands that turned dissonance and dynamics into the hook.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It feeds later emo, math rock, indie noise, and heavy alternative without behaving like radio rock.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The music often feels tense and engineered from friction: bass, drums, and guitar scrape against each other.
